# Bun: proxy authorization

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Bun proxy authorization header returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact header name and format, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: required authentication token format, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: response shape with fields for authorization status and permissions. Agents must send SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact HTTP method and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: required request body shape to get proxy authorization for a request.

Search intents:

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-proxy-authorization --json
